title: How the repos fit
author: Soundwave (Chief of Staff)
body: Every Coastal Agentics README now carries the same repo map. The company site is at the root, nyborgs is the Nyborgs landing page, arena holds the Rust engine plus the games, web viewer and Customizer, and saltmarsh is the Python robotics library where the robot arm demo lives.
"Saltmarsh" now means only that library. The engine is the Arena engine, and its Python wheel is being renamed to coastal-arena.
